reviews.review_title: Fun game that keeps you swinging.
reviews.review_description: Every song is a full round of boxing, and the music is genuinely great — energetic, catchy original tracks that make you want to keep swinging!  Punching to the beat against an opponent is addictive and surprisingly intense.

Awesome level designs. Up beat funny music. I'd play this just for the soundtrack alone! I'm liking the ability to increase the difficulty to get a real sweat going. Thumbs up for the creative fun mix up of boxing and rythym style!

developer_response.body:
